title: AM–GM inequality for two nonnegative reals
statement:
For any nonnegative real numbers $a, b \ge 0$, the geometric mean is at most the arithmetic mean:
\[
\sqrt{ab} \;\le\; \frac{a+b}{2}.
\]
replaced:
For nonnegative reals $a,b\ge 0$, the geometric mean is at most the arithmetic mean:
\[
\sqrt{ab} \;\le\; \frac{a+b}{2}.
\]
